scripts.examples:aisdk-rag-chatbox: pnpm turbo build --filter=@condev-monitor/nextjs && pnpm --filter aisdk-rag-chatbox dev
scripts.examples:animation-fixtures: pnpm build:sdk && pnpm --parallel --filter lemon-bureau --filter nico-palmer --filter salle-blanche dev
scripts.examples:node: node -e "console.error('examples/node 暂无可运行项目'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.examples:rag: pnpm build:sdk && sh -c 'pnpm --filter ragzbxy dev & frontend=$!; cleanup() { trap - EXIT INT TERM; kill "$frontend" 2>/dev/null || true; docker compose -p condev-monitor-rag -f examples/rag/backend/docker-compose.yml down; }; trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM; docker compose -p condev-monitor-rag -f examples/rag/backend/docker-compose.yml up --build'
scripts.examples:react: pnpm turbo build --filter=@condev-monitor/react && pnpm --filter example-react dev --host 127.0.0.1 --port 43112 --strictPort
scripts.docker:start: docker compose -p condev-monitor -f .devcontainer/docker-compose.yml up -d && COMPOSE_FILE=.devcontainer/docker-compose.yml pnpm docker:init-postgres && pnpm docker:init-kafka && COMPOSE_FILE=.devcontainer/docker-compose.yml pnpm docker:init-clickhouse
scripts.test:animation-rum-v2:release: pnpm --filter dsn-server test:animation-rum-v2:pipeline && pnpm --filter monitor test:animation-rum-v2:clickhouse
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format && pnpm spellcheck
